point_lights_scene_wide.verdict: FAIL scene-wide — atmosphere contributes 1 (oculus uplight); remaining 31 are legacy scene/furniture/characters (8 dome thresholds, 8 mezzanine ring, 6 furniture, ~9 characters+misc) owned by their lanes for the integration pass

budget_check.bloom_cut_rule: 60fps-with-post NOT met (~6.5 fps), but bloom measures ~0 fps cost at the current DC-bound bottleneck — cutting it today buys nothing. Per bible §8 item 5 the cut decision applies after items 1-3 land and instancing takes DC under 300; recommend re-measuring at the integration pass before cutting

fog_bias_numeric_ab.note: tour's final leg approaches the antechamber coordinates (-19,-19); density ramps only with bias enabled. Full bias (0.016) is reached inside r=5; the spline ends partway into the falloff. W1's blockout (PR #294) is not in this branch, so screenshots of the leg show no zone geometry — numeric A/B is the evidence

activity_reactive_ambience.reading: reactive ambience adds 0 draw calls and ~0 fps cost — it only scales emissive/rate/speed on existing objects (LAW <= 1.5x idle, bible §7); driven via getAgentRuntimeStates() from shared/agentStatus, demo'd through the DEV-only __worldDev harness feeding source='daemon'

reduce_motion: permagent-reduce-motion=true: starfield/dust/arcs static (rm-1 vs rm-2 — W4-owned elements identical; only legacy floor-vein pulse and stargate shimmer animate, owned by their lanes), tour 't' renders a static establishing shot with no drift (rm-3 vs rm-4), reactive ambience frozen at idle via setAmbienceFrozen
